items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: I'd use Gosley's drums instead of moving my stuff down there... So I put Gosley in for two weeks... they didn't even want him back.

ctx.x: Well, did they have any fakers out there? No?

No, they were all readers. They played overtures and things like that. Overtures and played, that's how I got to know all this crap. I mean, in fact, when I went to this, when I was in high school, I got a job at the Liberty Theater as an usher working just weekends in high school during the school season. I think we got a dollar or two dollars a day. And you'd always get tips on Saturday and Sunday when you'd have an over crowd of people and you'd get people to sit. You have one of these flash boxes with green…
That's a trick. They don't know that you made a mistake.
